stock-starter-team-patcher.head: 626180b0312336ff9b7812fa4d918c3523ab4763
stock-starter-team-patcher.scope: Stock team join followed by self-casts at one stand. The clear 2.5 m and 4.5 m teammates receive the four Firewall records. A 13.5 m teammate and a nearby nonmember receive none.

area.source: GOB 42 reapplies 695, a friendly team effect with a stored 3 m radius. The parent has a separate 8 m radius field.
area.runtime: AbilityAuras.Pulse passes the child to AbilitySupport.Land so the range and admission come from 695.
area.test: StarterTeamPatcherBuffsMode and PR586 show that only the 2.5 m teammate gets both +64 child records. The 4.5 m and 13.5 m teammates and the 2 m nonmember get neither. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/586

area.source: GOB 63 stores friendly team target selection with radius 10 m.
area.runtime: AbilitySupport.Land uses the caster-centred team collection with the ability's radius.
area.test: PR586 and StarterTeamPatcherBuffsMode include the 2.5 and 4.5 m teammates and exclude the 13.5 m teammate. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/586

targeting.source: GOB 63 is a beneficial team cast with no hostile hit contest.
targeting.runtime: AbilitySupport uses the buff's recipient mode to include self and eligible members of the mission team, excluding other nearby players.
targeting.test: The unselected stock cast in PR586 affects self and two in-range teammates. The nearby friendly nonmember has no 63 records. StarterTeamPatcherBuffsMode independently verifies those recipients' streams. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/586

stats.source: GOB 63 has one scaled viral defense, three +5 defenses, and RefundIS for 10 at termination after 300 s.
stats.runtime: AbilityBuffs stores defense modifiers at the source's cast rank, consumes them through AbilityStats and refunds IS to the recipient on term.
stats.test: FirewallAndShieldRefundRecipientInnerStrengthOnTerm verifies all four defense totals at rank 50, their removal and a single +10 refund on term. PR586 confirms the stock +35/+5/+5/+5 records and 300 s durations. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/586

behavior-tests.source: GOB 63 specifies 50 IS, a 10 m team cast, four defense modifiers and a 10 IS termination refund.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHandler debits the cast from the caster. AbilitySupport applies the 300 s snapshot to each eligible recipient; AbilityBuffs clears it and refunds the recipient.
behavior-tests.test: StarterTeamPatcherBuffsMode checks all four recipient records, the distant teammate and the nonmember. FirewallAndShieldRefundRecipientInnerStrengthOnTerm verifies the single refund and clears all four defense contributions. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/586

area.source: GOB 72 is a caster-centred friendly team buff with radius 14 m and +20 Combat Evasion for 600 s.
area.runtime: AbilitySupport uses the 14 m recipient radius on the team buff.
area.test: StarterTeamPatcherBuffsMode and the stock PR586 cast deliver the +20 record to CSR and all three teammates, including the 13.5 m member that 63 excluded. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/586

targeting.source: GOB 72 selects the caster and nearby friendly mission-team members, without a hostile contest.
targeting.runtime: AbilitySupport's team selector excludes nonmembers even within the radius.
targeting.test: The stock PR586 CSEQ 87 is cast with no world target. QAOther at 2 m receives no 72 record, which the exact replay verifies in the outsider's stream. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/586
